rename.to: Liquibase MongoDB migration fails on Quarkus upgrade from 3.21.4 to 3.26.3 for native test- MongoCommandException: no such command '$db'

body: I also ran into this issue when updating from 3.20.3 LTS to 3.27.0 LTS. Any updates on the topic? Thanks in advance.
Using the reproducer attached, I didn't see the tests reports mentioned. If anyone has an updated reproducer that I can use to see the problem in action, I can have a look.

@geoand the reported message does not appear in the test output, but rather in the standard output, which is not printed on the terminal by default. Adding `-i` to the given command shows the described error (at least for me). ``` ./gradlew clean testNative -i -Dquarkus.native.enabled=true -Dquarkus.native.container-build=false -Dquarkus.package.jar.enabled=false ``` Alternatively, you can open the generated test report and navigate to "Standard output"
